ValidationRule.description: If a custom payment plan deposit is below 40%, it requires Sales Manager approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Confirmed"), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Social_Event", Custom_Payment_Plan__c = true, Deposit_Percentage__c < 40, Payment_Plan_Approved__c = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Custom Payment Plans with a deposit below 40% require Sales Manager approval. Please submit for approval or check Payment Plan Approved.
